title: Reading the Status Light
situation: Alex starts his shift and sees a red status light on the machine. He calls Sam to describe the light and the error message. They check the power switch, the cable, and the connector, then restart the machine. The light is still red, so Sam asks Alex to stop and follow the official SOP.
objective: Describe a status light and an error message, ask simple present questions with there is, check a cable and connector safely, and report the result of a restart.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Hi, Sam. This is Alex. I'm calling about the machine on my line.
dialogue.indonesian: Hai, Sam. Ini Alex. Saya menelepon tentang mesin di jalur saya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Hi, Alex. What is the machine doing right now?
dialogue.indonesian: Hai, Alex. Apa yang sedang dilakukan mesin itu sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The status light is red, and it is blinking slowly.
dialogue.indonesian: Lampu statusnya merah, dan berkedip pelan.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Is there an error message on the display?
dialogue.indonesian: Apakah ada pesan error di layar?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, there is. The message says, 'Check connection.'

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thanks. Is the power switch on?
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah sakelar dayanya menyala?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, the power switch is on, and the display is on too.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, sakelar dayanya menyala, dan layarnya juga menyala.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Okay. Please check the cable and the connector. Follow the official SOP and safety rules before you check the power or open any panel.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Mohon periksa kabel dan konektornya. Ikuti SOP resmi dan aturan keselamatan sebelum memeriksa daya atau membuka panel apa pun.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Understood. I'm checking the cable and the connector now.
dialogue.indonesian: Dipahami. Saya sedang memeriksa kabel dan konektornya sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you. What do you see?
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apa yang Anda lihat?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The cable looks fine, and the connector is in place.
dialogue.indonesian: Kabelnya terlihat baik, dan konektornya terpasang.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good. Please restart the machine and tell me what happens.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Mohon mulai ulang mesinnya dan beri tahu saya apa yang terjadi.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I restarted the machine, but the status light is still red, and the error message is still there.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sudah memulai ulang mesinnya, tetapi lampu statusnya masih merah, dan pesan errornya masih ada.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you, Alex. Please stop here and follow the official SOP. I'll ask Jordan to check the machine with you.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, Alex. Mohon berhenti di sini dan ikuti SOP resmi. Saya akan meminta Jordan memeriksa mesin itu bersama Anda.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Okay. I'll wait for Jordan. Thanks, Sam.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Saya akan menunggu Jordan. Terima kasih, Sam.

keyExpressions.english: I'm calling about the machine on my line.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya menelepon tentang mesin di jalur saya.
keyExpressions.note: Present continuous (am + verb-ing) untuk tindakan yang sedang berlangsung.
Simple present untuk kondisi mesin saat ini.

keyExpressions.english: Is there an error message on the display?
keyExpressions.indonesian: Apakah ada pesan error di layar?
keyExpressions.note: Is there ...? menanyakan ada atau tidaknya sesuatu.
Pesan di layar dibaca dengan says.

keyExpressions.english: Please check the cable and the connector.

keyExpressions.note: Looks + adjective untuk kesan setelah melihat.

keyExpressions.english: The status light is still red.
keyExpressions.note: Still menunjukkan kondisi yang belum berubah.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Simple present untuk menjelaskan kondisi saat ini.
Present continuous untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung.
examples: The display is showing an error message.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Menanyakan ada atau tidaknya sesuatu di suatu tempat.
examples: Is there an error message on the display?
Is there a label on the connector?
Please check the cable and the connector.

learningNotes: Gunakan simple present untuk kondisi saat ini dan present continuous untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung.
Gunakan is there ...? untuk menanyakan apakah sesuatu ada; jawab dengan Yes, there is. atau No, there isn't.
Baca pesan di layar dengan tenang, lalu ulangi pesan itu kepada rekan Anda.
Follow the official SOP and safety rules before checking power or opening panels.

pronunciationNotes.title: status
pronunciationNotes.note: Di Amerika, status umumnya diucapkan STAY-tus (/ˈsteɪtəs/), dengan tekanan di suku kata pertama.

pronunciationNotes.title: connector
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata kedua: kuh-NEK-tur (/kəˈnɛktər/).
